limitations: --replace-duplicates generic type parameterization (US-049): type constraints are NOT inferred. When duplicates differ by user-defined generic type arguments (e.g. List<MyType> vs List<OtherType>), the extracted method gets <T> but no 'where T : ...' constraint is emitted. This means the generated method may not compile if the body calls type-specific members. Deferred: constraint inference requires semantic analysis of all member access on T across all call sites.

--replace-duplicates generic type parameterization: only user-defined type arguments (IdentifierNameSyntax) are detected as varying. Predefined keyword types (int, string, bool, etc.) produce a PatternMatcher structural mismatch so duplicates differing only in keyword types are not detected as generic candidates.
